name: Absordex
description: (Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:implant)(Tag:life)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Blood Collection", Absordex is a fang Teigu that drains living beings' blood by biting to restore your energy and temporarily boost physical abilities. Returns scale with blood quality and quantity. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
